    Lifting graded modules and maps to ℤ/4 (Proposition 10.1, the lifting steps) #

    integral-deformations.tex (proof of prop:fixed-integral-companion): "Lift the action matrices arbitrarily to free graded 𝒪-modules. Their associativity defect is even. Division by two, followed by reduction, gives an Ext² class of degree zero. Equation (prime-field-ext-vanishing) supplies a correction. Since (2𝒪)² = 0, this single correction makes the action associative. The same bar calculation, using Ext¹, gives uniqueness and lifts all homogeneous maps of nonnegative degree."

    Setting: a graded 𝔽₂-algebra Λ, a graded 𝒪-algebra Λ̃ (𝒪 = ℤ/4) and a reduction π : Λ̃ → Λ. A lift of a graded Λ-module M is a graded Λ̃-module M̃ with a reduction ρ : M̃ → M whose kernel is 2M̃ and the annihilator of two (IsLift). Twice a lift (tw) and division by two (half) are well defined; maps of degree d lift when Ext¹_d vanishes (exists_liftHom).

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.WLift.IsRed {Λ : Type u_1} [Ring Λ] [Algebra (ZMod 2) Λ] {Λ' : Type u_2} [Ring Λ'] [Algebra (ZMod 4) Λ'] (GΛ' : GExt.GAlg Λ') (GΛ : GExt.GAlg Λ) (π : Λ' →+* Λ) :
    Prop

    A reduction of graded algebras Λ̃ → Λ along ℤ/4 → 𝔽₂.

    • smul (a : ZMod 4) (x : Λ') : π (a • x) = Z4.red a • π x
    • deg (p : ℤ) (x : Λ') : GΛ'.gr.IsHom p x → GΛ.gr.IsHom p (π x)
    • lift (p : ℤ) (x : Λ) : GΛ.gr.IsHom p x → ∃ (x' : Λ'), GΛ'.gr.IsHom p x' ∧ π x' = x
    • ker (x : Λ') : π x = 0 → ∃ (y : Λ'), x = 2 • y
    • ann (x : Λ') : 2 • x = 0 → π x = 0

      • ker (m : M') : ρ m = 0 → ∃ (m' : M'), m = 2 • m'
      • ann (m : M') : 2 • m = 0 → ρ m = 0
